title: Two Best Non-Overlapping Events
goal: Maximize the total value of at most two nonoverlapping events.
strategy: Sort by start time and prepare suffix maximum values. For each first event, binary-search the first start strictly after its inclusive end, then combine with the best eligible suffix event.
